data.body: /dso:fix-bug BASIC investigation: brainstorm Step 2.27 (cross-resource scan) currently handles ambiguity/conflict resolution only — it does NOT audit new git ref patterns against existing .github/workflows/*.yml trigger filters. Proposed fix: add a workflow-trigger-filter audit step to Step 2.27 — when epic deliverables include a new git ref pattern, dispatch a haiku sub-agent to enumerate workflow trigger filters and flag any that would silently exclude the new ref. Classification: MODERATE — brainstorm SKILL.md addition + possibly skills/brainstorm/phases/cross-epic-handlers.md. Likely combines with jira-dig-2562 (same gap, focused on PR merge strategy changes). Not addressed in this P2 pass; leaving OPEN.
